2608.19880.title: EnvHarness: Awakening Static Worlds for Agent Learning
2608.19880.paper_summary: LLM agents learn by interacting with environments, yet these environments are hand-built and static: blind to an agent's weaknesses, and quickly left behind as it improves. While recent environment generation methods attempt to address this, they require domain-specific pipelines, rely on expensive or unreliable verifiers, and still produce static environments. To alleviate the engineering burden of rebuilding environments from scratch, we propose Environment Harness (EnvHarness), a programmable layer of plug-in components that wraps a static environment to reshape its behavior without modifying the underlying logic. Operating through standard interfaces, EnvHarness applies across diverse domains while ensuring every reshaped environment retains its original verifier. To automate this process, we introduce EnvRigger, which treats the target policy as a black box, observing its execution trajectories to synthesize EnvHarness components targeting diagnosed flaws, and validating them via fresh rollouts. Across five benchmarks in four domains, EnvHarness outperforms both original environments and domain-specific environment generation pipelines, achieving up to a 9.0-point improvement on held-out instances with 9.8% fewer execution steps. Furthermore, EnvHarness provides a superior optimization signal for reinforcement learning, enabling continuous, targeted co-evolution of the policy and its environment.
2608.19880.paper_summary_zh: LLM 代理透過與環境互動來學習，但這些環境是手動構建且靜態的：對代理的弱點視而不見，並且隨著代理的進步而迅速被拋在腦後。雖然最近的環境生成方法試圖解決這個問題，但它們需要特定領域的管道，依賴昂貴或不可靠的驗證器，並且仍然產生靜態環境。為了減輕從頭重建環境的工程負擔，我們提出了環境工具（EnvHarness），這是一個可編程的插件組件層，包裹靜態環境以改變其行為，而不修改底層邏輯。EnvHarness 通過標準接口運作，適用於多種領域，同時確保每個改變過的環境保留其原始驗證器。為了自動化這個過程，我們引入了 EnvRigger，它將目標策略視為黑箱，觀察其執行軌跡以合成針對診斷缺陷的 EnvHarness 組件，並通過新的回合進行驗證。在四個領域的五個基準測試中，EnvHarness 的表現超過了原始環境和特定領域的環境生成管道，在保留實例上實現了高達 9.0 點的改進，執行步驟減少了 9.8%。此外，EnvHarness 為增強學習提供了更優的優化信號，使政策和其環境能夠持續、針對性地共同演化。
